weights.load: transformers CLIPModel + CLIPImageProcessor + CLIPTokenizerFast, eval mode, CPU

geometry.source: Text2CAD v1.0 dataset misc/minimal_json/minimal_json_0000_0099.zip (gallery.jsonl minimal_json_member per UID)
geometry.loader: CadSeqProc CADSequence.from_minimal_json (official Text2CAD repo, local mirror git 669a81472ede2269837c22a4d00070eaac360c82)
geometry.normalize_note: CadSeqProc CADSequence.normalize() is NOT used: minimal_json lacks properties.bounding_box (logged integration gap); geometric normalization happens on the mesh instead
geometry.mesh_normalization: center = vertex mean; scale = max vertex distance from center -> unit sphere (identical to the 32/32 probe batch)

camera.view: single fixed canonical isometric: azim=45 deg, elev=30 deg
camera.framing: box_aspect (1,1,1); axis cube centered at mesh center with radius = max vertex radius
camera.lighting: none (flat facecolor #9db8d9, no edge) - identical to the probe batch
camera.resolution: figsize 2.24x2.24 inch at dpi 200 -> 448x448 px, bbox_inches tight, pad_inches 0

image_preprocessing: CLIPImageProcessor defaults: resize 224 shortest side, center crop 224, CLIP normalization

text_preprocessing.input: canonical unique stripped text from pair_manifest_v4_worker/texts.jsonl (the G5 frozen text axis)

scoring.embeddings: projected image / text features (get_image_features / get_text_features); L2-normalized; cosine similarity = dot product
scoring.precision: encode float32, matrix stored float64 little-endian
scoring.matrix_layout: rows = unique text_index 0..3643 (canonical stripped-text order), cols = cad_index 0..8045 (frozen gallery order)

first_batch_gate.uids: 8 per gallery-length quartile (G5 boundary rule searchsorted-left), 32 total
checks: image and text vectors finite and non-zero (L2 norm > 0)
UID alignment: every render maps to exactly one frozen gallery cad_index
truncation: count unique texts exceeding 77 CLIP tokens; encode 2 of them; vectors finite
first_batch_gate.reuse: probe renders from runtime/clip_probe_20261115/renders and clip_probe_smoke_20261115/renders are copied in and reused (same frozen spec)

engineering_policy: per-UID failures retried once; persistent failures recorded with reasons; coverage < 8046 triggers sub-library mode (entry supports kept-query ceilings) and the failure list is a hard deliverable
